newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hellmann adds new Finland, Bulgaria forwarding par.
newsitem.headline: Hellmann adds new Finland, Bulgaria forwarding par.

text.p: German freight forwarder Hellmann International Forwarders has added new partners in Finland and Bulgaria to its international co-operation network.
The new Finnish partner is Nordic Logistic Service which has offices in Helsinki and Tampere, a company statement said.
Werta Spedition, Sofia, has been accepted as the new Bulgarian partner.
Both new members of Hellmann Group of Partners offer air and sea freight and other forwarding services, Hellmann said.
The network, which is now represented in 126 countries, is linked by the Hellogic tracking and tracing system for intercontinental shipments, the company added.
